selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 修饰形容词、副词或动词，表示程度不大。
example_en: I feel a bit tired after the long walk.
example_zh: 走了很长一段路后，我觉得有点累。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 修饰可数名词复数，表示数量虽少但并非没有。
example_en: A few students stayed to clean the classroom.
example_zh: 几个学生留下来打扫教室。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可修饰不可数名词，也可表示程度较小。
example_en: There is a little milk left in the fridge.
example_zh: 冰箱里还剩一点牛奶。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可修饰动词表示程度，也可单独表示大量事物。
example_en: We learned a lot from the science project.
example_zh: 我们从这个科学项目中学到了很多。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或代词，说明信息来源或判断依据。
example_en: According to the map, the library is near the park.
example_zh: 根据地图，图书馆在公园附近。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于补充一个应当考虑的理由或事实。
example_en: Be patient with him; after all, he is new here.
example_zh: 对他耐心一点，毕竟他刚来这里。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某事物分布在某地的各处。
example_en: Wild flowers grow all over the hill in spring.
example_zh: 春天，野花开遍整座山丘。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示同意、接受，也可说明情况良好。
example_en: Do not worry; everything will be all right.
example_zh: 别担心，一切都会好起来的。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某种情况在一段时间内持续发生。
example_en: The baby smiled all the time during the visit.
example_zh: 在探访期间，宝宝一直在笑。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示整个路程或过程没有中断。
example_en: We talked all the way home.
example_zh: 我们一路聊着回到家。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示事情按照平常的方式发生。
example_en: My father got up early as usual.
example_zh: 我父亲像往常一样早起。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常放在肯定句句末，补充同类的人或事。
example_en: Lucy can speak French, and she can speak Spanish as well.
example_zh: 露西会说法语，也会说西班牙语。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于否定句或疑问句，加强“任何程度”的含义。
example_en: I was not nervous at all before the speech.
example_zh: 演讲前我一点也不紧张。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于说明最初的情况，后文常出现变化。
example_en: At first, the puzzle looked difficult, but we soon solved it.
example_zh: 起初这个谜题看起来很难，但我们很快就解开了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常表示人在住所，也可表示处于熟悉自在的状态。
example_en: I will stay at home and finish my book tonight.
example_zh: 今晚我会待在家里把书读完。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调经过等待、努力或耽搁后某事发生。
example_en: The rain stopped at last, and the match began.
example_zh: 雨终于停了，比赛开始了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示数量或程度不低于某个限度。
example_en: Please read at least ten pages every day.
example_zh: 请每天至少读十页。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示不延迟地做某事。
example_en: When you smell smoke, leave the room at once.
example_zh: 闻到烟味时，要立刻离开房间。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示两件事同时发生，也可引出与前文并存的另一面。
example_en: The twins reached the finish line at the same time.
example_zh: 这对双胞胎同时到达终点。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示每次只处理限定数量的人或事物。
example_en: Carry two boxes at a time to stay safe.
example_zh: 为了安全，每次搬两个箱子。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示某人正在工作，也可表示某种力量正在发挥作用。
example_en: My mother is still at work, so she will come later.
example_zh: 我妈妈还在工作，所以她会晚些来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示不用机器，而是亲手完成。
example_en: Grandpa made this wooden toy by hand.
example_zh: 爷爷亲手制作了这个木制玩具。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于转换到与当前话题相关的补充内容。
example_en: By the way, did you bring your library card?
example_zh: 顺便问一下，你带图书证了吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调某事持续进行或在白天和夜晚都发生。
example_en: The doctors worked day and night to help the patients.
example_zh: 医生们日夜工作，救助病人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于两人或多人之间的相互行为。
example_en: Good teammates listen to each other.
example_zh: 优秀的队友会互相倾听。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 作时间状语，说明动作每日发生；与形容词 everyday 区分。
example_en: I water these plants every day.
example_zh: 我每天给这些植物浇水。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 作时间状语，说明动作每个星期发生。
example_en: Our class has a reading meeting every week.
example_zh: 我们班每周举行一次读书会。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 作时间状语，说明动作或事件每年发生。
example_en: Many visitors come to the town every year.
example_zh: 每年都有许多游客来到这个小镇。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某个动作或状态持续一段不太长的时间。
example_en: Let us sit here and rest for a while.
example_zh: 我们坐在这里休息一会儿吧。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于引出能够说明前面观点的具体例子。
example_en: Some animals, for example, bears, sleep through much of the winter.
example_zh: 有些动物，例如熊，会睡过冬季的大部分时间。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示获得某物或服务时不需要付钱。
example_en: Children can enter the museum for free on Sundays.
example_zh: 孩子们星期日可以免费进入博物馆。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于说明一个较长名称的简短说法。
example_en: We call the International Space Station the ISS for short.
example_zh: 我们把国际空间站简称为 ISS。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示说话人对某事很有把握。
example_en: I cannot say for sure when the bus will arrive.
example_zh: 我无法确切地说公共汽车什么时候到。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某事间隔一段时间发生一次。
example_en: We visit our old teacher from time to time.
example_zh: 我们不时去看望以前的老师。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于祝愿别人顺利或成功。
example_en: Good luck with your English test tomorrow!
example_zh: 祝你明天的英语考试顺利！

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示分散在不同地方，不一定遍及全部区域。
example_en: Small cafés appeared here and there along the street.
example_zh: 街道两旁零星分布着一些小咖啡馆。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于给出全部数量。
example_en: There are thirty students in all in our music club.
example_zh: 我们的音乐社团总共有三十名学生。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 have 连用，说明人或事物具有相同点。
example_en: The two friends have a love of music in common.
example_zh: 这两个朋友都热爱音乐。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于补充真实情况，或纠正可能的误解。
example_en: The task looks simple, but in fact it needs careful planning.
example_zh: 这项任务看起来简单，其实需要周密计划。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于 wait 或 stand 等动词后，表示按队列排列。
example_en: Please wait in line outside the ticket office.
example_zh: 请在售票处外排队等候。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示事物排列整齐或处于适当状态。
example_en: Put the pictures in order to tell the story.
example_zh: 把图片按顺序排列来讲述这个故事。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于用简短的话概括前面的内容。
example_en: In short, regular practice is the key to improvement.
example_zh: 总之，经常练习是进步的关键。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示经过一段过程后的最终结果。
example_en: We tried several routes and chose the safest one in the end.
example_zh: 我们尝试了几条路线，最后选择了最安全的一条。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示阻挡通道或妨碍事情进行。
example_en: Your bicycle is in the way, so please move it.
example_zh: 你的自行车挡路了，请把它移开。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在最后时刻赶上，没有错过。
example_en: We reached the station just in time for the last train.
example_zh: 我们正好及时赶上末班火车。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在当前时间之后的某个时候。
example_en: I am busy now, but I can help you later on.
example_zh: 我现在很忙，但之后可以帮你。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示数量或程度持续增加。
example_en: More and more students ride bicycles to school.
example_zh: 越来越多的学生骑自行车上学。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示紧邻的房屋或房间。
example_en: A friendly family moved in next door last week.
example_zh: 上周有一家友善的人搬到了隔壁。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示确信，也可表示某事极有可能发生。
example_en: No doubt, teamwork helped us finish early.
example_zh: 毫无疑问，团队合作帮助我们提前完成了任务。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与疑问词连用，引出不影响结果的条件。
example_en: No matter what happens, stay calm and ask for help.
example_zh: 无论发生什么，都要保持冷静并寻求帮助。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示某事停止发生，也可说明数量已经没有剩余。
example_en: There is no more juice in the bottle.
example_zh: 瓶子里没有果汁了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某事不经常但会间或发生。
example_en: We eat at that small restaurant now and then.
example_zh: 我们偶尔会去那家小餐馆吃饭。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示回答肯定、事情显而易见或愿意提供帮助。
example_en: Of course you can borrow my dictionary.
example_zh: 你当然可以借我的词典。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与 be 连用，表示某物正在燃烧。
example_en: The dry grass was on fire, so we called for help.
example_zh: 干草着火了，所以我们打电话求助。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某个行为是有意做出的，而非偶然。
example_en: She left the window open on purpose to let fresh air in.
example_zh: 她故意把窗户开着，好让新鲜空气进来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 to 连用表示去某地途中，也可表示某事即将发生。
example_en: We bought some bread on the way to school.
example_zh: 我们在上学路上买了一些面包。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在约定或规定的时刻，不早也不晚。
example_en: The school bus arrived on time this morning.
example_zh: 校车今天早上准时到达。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示同一动作或情况再次发生。
example_en: Once again, our class won the basketball game.
example_zh: 我们班又一次赢得了篮球比赛。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于请求或说明动作再重复一次。
example_en: Please read the last sentence once more.
example_zh: 请把最后一句再读一遍。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于警告不采取前述行动会产生某种后果。
example_en: Wear your coat, or else you may feel cold outside.
example_zh: 穿上外套，否则你在外面可能会觉得冷。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把原本可默念的内容说出声音来。
example_en: The teacher asked us to read the poem out loud.
example_zh: 老师让我们大声朗读这首诗。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调同一动作发生很多次。
example_en: He practiced the difficult line over and over.
example_zh: 他反复练习那句困难的台词。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示毫不拖延地采取行动。
example_en: Please wash the cut right away.
example_zh: 请立即清洗伤口。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与现在完成时连用，说明截至现在的情况。
example_en: So far, we have collected fifty books for the library.
example_zh: 到目前为止，我们已经为图书馆募集了五十本书。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调某种情况从过去持续到现在，或直到现在才改变。
example_en: Until now, I have never traveled by plane.
example_zh: 直到现在，我还从未坐过飞机旅行。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示沿上下方向移动，也可表示来回走动。
example_en: The excited puppy jumped up and down.
example_zh: 兴奋的小狗跳上跳下。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示动作完成得好，也可用于接受建议或安排。
example_en: Mina plays the piano very well.
example_zh: 米娜钢琴弹得很好。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接所请求的人、物或帮助。
example_en: You can ask for help when the task is difficult.
example_zh: 任务困难时，你可以请求帮助。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常后接较小的地点，也可表示经过思考得出结论。
example_en: We expect to arrive at the station before noon.
example_zh: 我们预计中午前到达车站。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常使用被动形式，后可接时间或地点状语。
example_en: The baby will be born in early spring.
example_zh: 这个宝宝将在初春出生。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接人或事物，表示相信其存在、价值或能力。
example_en: You must believe in yourself when facing a challenge.
example_zh: 面对挑战时，你必须相信自己。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接拥有者，通常不用于进行时或被动语态。
example_en: These gloves belong to my sister.
example_zh: 这副手套属于我姐姐。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指机器停止运转，也可指物质分解或人情绪失控。
example_en: Old buses may break down on long journeys.
example_zh: 旧公共汽车在长途行驶中可能会出故障。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指强行进入建筑物，也可指打断谈话。
example_en: Someone tried to break in through the back window.
example_zh: 有人试图从后窗闯入。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指把人或物带回，也可表示唤起记忆。
example_en: This song can bring back happy childhood memories.
example_zh: 这首歌能唤起快乐的童年回忆。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指降低价格、数量或水平，也可指使某物倒下。
example_en: Better farming methods can bring down food prices.
example_zh: 更好的耕作方法能够降低食品价格。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指把某物带回家，也可表示使人清楚认识某事。
example_en: The accident should bring home the importance of road safety.
example_zh: 这起事故应让人深刻认识到道路安全的重要性。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示某种情况需要某物，也可公开要求采取行动。
example_en: The problem will call for patience and teamwork.
example_zh: 解决这个问题需要耐心和团队合作。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指提高声音喊话，也可指召集人员处理紧急情况。
example_en: If you see the guide, call out her name.
example_zh: 如果你看到导游，就大声喊她的名字。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可单独使用，也可接宾语表示使某人镇静。
example_en: Take a slow breath and calm down before you answer.
example_zh: 回答前慢慢吸一口气，让自己平静下来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示照料某人，也可用于较正式语境表示喜欢某物。
example_en: Nurses care for people who are ill.
example_zh: 护士照顾生病的人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在困难或中断后继续做某事。
example_en: Please carry on with your work while I answer the phone.
example_zh: 我接电话时，请继续做你的工作。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示抵达酒店或机场后登记身份和相关信息。
example_en: We need to check in at the hotel before six.
example_zh: 我们需要在六点前办理酒店入住手续。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 查看；办理退房；结账离开
usage_note_zh: 可表示查看某物，也可表示办理离开酒店的手续。
example_en: Guests must check out before noon.
example_zh: 客人必须在中午前办理退房。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可不接宾语，也可接需要清理的地方或物品。
example_en: Everyone helped clean up the park after the picnic.
example_zh: 野餐后，大家一起清理了公园。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调沿某物向上移动。
example_en: The children watched the cat climb up the tree.
example_zh: 孩子们看着猫爬上树。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可用于邀请别人同行，也可说明事情的进展情况。
example_en: You may come along with us if you have time.
example_zh: 如果你有时间，可以和我们一起来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示返回原处，也可表示某种事物重新出现。
example_en: Please come back before it gets dark.
example_zh: 请在天黑前回来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从高处向低处移动，也可指价格或温度下降。
example_en: Snow began to come down before sunrise.
example_zh: 日出前开始下雪了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于表示人进入室内，也可指某物开始流行或到达。
example_en: Please knock before you come in.
example_zh: 进来之前请敲门。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于催促或鼓励，也可表示某事开始出现。
example_en: Come on, we do not want to miss the opening show.
example_zh: 快点，我们可不想错过开场表演。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 用沙子安全地扑灭小篝火。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 我们花了一个小时组装新书架。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 受惊的马试图逃离噪声。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 我经常在市场偶遇以前的邻居。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 我们可能在到达营地前耗尽饮用水。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 我们计划明天日出前出发。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 学校本学期将成立一个新的科学社团。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某人到达约定地点，常含终于出现或意外出现的意味。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示到场登记，也可表示进入计算机账户。

example_zh: 访客必须在前台登记。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示从站立状态变为坐姿，也可用于礼貌地请人入座。

example_zh: 请坐下等待叫到你的名字。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示降低移动速度，也可指放慢工作或生活节奏。

example_zh: 驾驶员在学校门口附近应减速。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 和某人说话；对某人讲话

example_zh: 我想和负责人谈一谈。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示提高音量，也可表示公开说出意见。

example_zh: 请大声一点，让大家都能听见。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从坐姿起立，也可与 for 连用表示支持或维护。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示到了通常睡觉的时间仍保持清醒。

example_zh: 上学日前不要熬夜太晚。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示进入某处，也常指为了帮助或制止问题而介入。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示关闭电器、灯或设备的电源。

example_zh: 离开房间时请关掉风扇。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示接通电器、灯或设备的电源。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可单独用于提醒或告别；表示照顾某人时通常接 of。

example_zh: 穿过这条繁忙的道路时要当心。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从高处拿下、记录信息或拆除结构。

example_zh: 请在忘记前记下这个电话号码。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可接衣物作宾语，也可不接宾语表示飞机离地。

example_zh: 飞机将在二十分钟后起飞。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与 in 连用，后接活动、比赛或讨论。

example_zh: 每名学生都可以参加艺术节。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 主语通常是事件或活动，不用于被动语态。

example_zh: 决赛将在星期六下午举行。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示培养兴趣、占用时间或空间，也可表示拿起事物。
example_en: Reading does not have to take up all your free time.
example_zh: 阅读不必占用你全部的空闲时间。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接谈话的主题或事情。

example_zh: 我们来谈谈暑假计划吧。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接谈话对象；强调双方交流时也常用 talk with。

example_zh: 如果你需要建议，应该和老师谈谈。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接需要认真考虑的人、事或行动。
example_en: Please think about the question before you answer.
example_zh: 回答前请认真思考这个问题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示脑中出现某人或某事，也可用于询问看法。
example_en: Can you think of a better name for our team?
example_zh: 你能为我们的队伍想出一个更好的名字吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接不再需要的东西；代词作宾语时通常放在两词之间。

example_zh: 不要扔掉可以重复使用的纸。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示关闭电器、水源或设备；代词作宾语时通常放在两词之间。
example_en: Remember to turn off the tap after washing your hands.
example_zh: 洗手后记得关水龙头。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示开启电器、水源或设备；代词作宾语时通常放在两词之间。
example_en: Could you turn on the radio for the weather report?
example_zh: 你能打开收音机听天气预报吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常接形容词或不定式说明最终结果，也可表示关灯。
example_en: The missing keys may turn out to be in your bag.
example_zh: 丢失的钥匙最后可能会发现就在你的包里。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接方向、对象或可以提供帮助的人。

example_zh: 面临艰难选择时，你可以向父母求助。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可不接宾语表示醒来，也可接宾语表示把某人叫醒。
example_en: I usually wake up before my alarm rings.
example_zh: 我通常在闹钟响之前醒来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示运动前活动身体，也可表示使食物或房间变暖。
example_en: Players should warm up before they enter the game.
example_zh: 运动员上场比赛前应该热身。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于提醒某人注意眼前或即将出现的危险。
example_en: Watch out! The steps are covered with ice.
example_zh: 当心！台阶上结了冰。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在某处工作；以某材料创作

example_zh: 许多年轻人希望在科技领域工作。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接正在处理的任务、项目或需要改善的能力。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示找到答案、计算结果，也可表示进行体育锻炼。

example_zh: 试着不用计算器算出答案。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接需要记录的信息；代词作宾语时通常放在两词之间。

example_zh: 写下你今天学到的三件事。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示空间距离近，也可表示数量或关系接近。

example_zh: 我们学校离市图书馆很近。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示空间距离远，也可强调实际情况与某种描述相差很大。

example_zh: 营地离最近的城镇很远。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示处于某人或某物外部的前方，与 in the front of 区分。

example_zh: 我们的教室前面有一棵大树。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: to 是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于疑问词后加强语气，也可按字面表示在地球上。

example_zh: 教室门到底为什么锁着？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接动词原形，表示过去的习惯或状态如今已经改变。

example_zh: 我们过去常常放学后在这片场地踢足球。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或不定式，比 want 语气更礼貌。

example_zh: 我想再问一个问题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接动词原形，可用于多种时态说明具备能力或条件。

example_zh: 多加练习后，你就能游得更远。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词、代词或动名词，说明害怕的对象。

example_zh: 起初害怕犯错是正常的。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于比较两个人或事物之间的差异。

example_zh: 小镇生活可能与大城市生活不同。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接构成内容或大量存在的人和事物。

example_zh: 五月时花园里将开满鲜花。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词、代词或动名词，说明擅长的领域或活动。

example_zh: 你不必样样都擅长。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词、代词或动名词，说明兴趣所在。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 实验时既要注意安全，也要享受其中的乐趣。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 我的外貌和性格都像父亲。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可单独使用，也可接 of 表示拍摄的对象。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 修理工当场修好了自行车。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 这一发现绝不是我们研究的终点。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示按照理论或计划应当如此，但现实结果可能不同。
example_en: In theory, the new system should save both time and energy.
example_zh: 理论上，新系统应该既省时又节能。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于说明不论其他情况怎样，某个结论或行动仍然成立。
example_en: At any rate, we should inform the team before changing the plan.
example_zh: 无论如何，我们改变计划前都应该通知团队。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常作表语或状语，说明商品或服务无需付费。
example_en: Students can use the sports center free of charge after class.
example_zh: 学生放学后可以免费使用体育中心。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示活动已经全面展开，正处在最活跃的阶段。
example_en: Preparations for the cultural festival are now in full swing.
example_zh: 文化节的准备工作现在正如火如荼地进行。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示按照稳定、重复的时间安排进行。
example_en: The equipment must be checked on a regular basis.
example_zh: 这些设备必须定期检查。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某种安排只在当前一段时间内有效，以后可能改变。
example_en: For the time being, the club will meet in the library.
example_zh: 俱乐部暂时将在图书馆举行活动。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 使无法靠近；使陷入困境
usage_note_zh: 常与 keep 或 hold 连用，表示阻止危险靠近或控制住问题。
example_en: Firefighters worked through the night to keep the flames at bay.
example_zh: 消防员彻夜工作，控制火势不让其蔓延。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可说明机器正在运行，也可说明制度或计划已经生效。
example_en: The new safety system has been in operation since June.
example_zh: 新的安全系统自六月以来一直在运行。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常指危险的人或动物逃脱后尚未被控制。
example_en: Residents were warned that a wild animal was on the loose.
example_zh: 居民接到警告，有一只野生动物逃脱在外。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指产品或制度处于试验阶段，也可指某人正在法庭受审。
example_en: The school is using the new timetable on trial this month.
example_zh: 学校本月正在试行新课表。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示长时间详细讨论，也可表示经过很久之后终于发生。
example_en: The committee discussed the proposal at length before voting.
example_zh: 委员会在表决前详细讨论了这项提议。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某事并不经常，但会在某些时候发生。
example_en: Even experienced speakers feel nervous on occasion.
example_zh: 即使经验丰富的演讲者偶尔也会紧张。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于引出同一问题的另一面或与前文形成对比的观点。
example_en: Online study is convenient; on the other hand, it requires self-discipline.
example_zh: 在线学习很方便；另一方面，它需要自律。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示通过思考、调查或计算找到答案或解决办法。
example_en: We need to figure out what caused the sudden power failure.
example_zh: 我们需要查明突然停电的原因。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示面对压力或困难时不改变决定、原则或立场。
example_en: The students decided to stand firm against unfair treatment.
example_zh: 学生们决定坚定反对不公平待遇。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接提供支持的人、事物或条件。
example_en: Farmers rely on accurate forecasts when planning their work.
example_zh: 农民安排工作时依靠准确的天气预报。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在失败、疾病或困难后较快恢复到良好状态。
example_en: The team managed to bounce back after losing its first match.
example_zh: 这支队伍在首场失利后成功恢复了状态。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调主动而努力地寻找某人、某物或机会。
example_en: Good learners seek out chances to use new vocabulary.
example_zh: 善于学习的人会主动寻找使用新词汇的机会。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接所离开的地点、危险或受限制的状态。
example_en: The villagers had little time to escape from the rising floodwater.
example_zh: 村民们几乎没有时间逃离不断上涨的洪水。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接疾病、危险或威胁，表示采取行动使其无法造成伤害。
example_en: Regular exercise may help ward off some health problems.
example_zh: 经常锻炼可能有助于预防一些健康问题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示为特定目的预留时间或资源，也可表示暂不考虑某事。
example_en: Try to set aside half an hour each day for reading.
example_zh: 尽量每天留出半小时阅读。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: to 是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词，表示逐渐适应。
example_en: It may take time to get used to studying in a new environment.
example_zh: 适应在新环境中学习可能需要时间。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指墙壁或屋顶向内倒塌，也可指人在压力下让步。
example_en: The old roof could cave in under the weight of the snow.
example_zh: 旧屋顶可能会在积雪的重压下坍塌。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把插头接入电源，也可指连接电子设备。
example_en: Do not plug in the machine with wet hands.
example_zh: 不要用湿手给机器接通电源。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示暂时搁置物品或分歧，也可表示储存时间或金钱。
example_en: Let us put aside our differences and solve the problem together.
example_zh: 让我们暂时搁置分歧，共同解决问题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示经过持续调查或寻找，最终找到某人、某物或信息。
example_en: The reporter managed to track down the original source of the story.
example_zh: 记者成功追查到了这则报道的原始来源。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示通过努力为自己创造事业、地位、空间或时间。
example_en: She hopes to carve out a career in environmental research.
example_zh: 她希望在环境研究领域开创一番事业。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指物体散开，也可指计划、关系或情绪失去稳定。
example_en: Without regular repairs, the wooden bridge may fall apart.
example_zh: 如果不定期维修，这座木桥可能会散架。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示整体断裂或被分成若干部分。
example_en: Large waves can break apart weak sections of sea ice.
example_zh: 巨浪可能使薄弱的海冰断裂开来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接会影响计算、判断或计划的因素。
example_en: We must factor in travel time when setting the meeting schedule.
example_zh: 安排会议时间时，我们必须把路途时间考虑在内。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与 of 连用，表示持续掌握数量、进度或位置的变化。
example_en: A simple chart can help you keep track of your reading progress.
example_zh: 一张简单的图表可以帮助你记录阅读进度。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示设备或系统连接，也可表示人与人会合或组织合作。
example_en: The two research teams plan to link up and share their results.
example_zh: 两个研究团队计划合作并共享成果。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示输入身份信息进入计算机系统或网络服务，常与 to 连用。
example_en: Students must log in with their school accounts.
example_zh: 学生必须使用学校账户登录。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与 to 连用，表示连接并进入计算机或网络系统。
example_en: You need a password to log on to the learning platform.
example_zh: 你需要密码才能登录学习平台。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示安全地结束计算机系统或网络账户的会话。
example_en: Always log out when you use a shared computer.
example_zh: 使用公用电脑时一定要退出登录。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于否定或条件语境，说明计划、想法或情况最终如何发展。
example_en: If the plan does not pan out, we will try another approach.
example_zh: 如果这个计划没有成功，我们会尝试另一种方法。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 before 连用，提醒人在行动前再次认真考虑。
example_en: Think twice before sharing personal information online.
example_zh: 在网上分享个人信息前要三思。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 把某人或某事牵扯进来
usage_note_zh: 表示把原本无关的人或话题不必要地卷入某件事。
example_en: Do not drag in other students who had nothing to do with the argument.
example_zh: 不要把与争论无关的其他学生牵扯进来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示令人厌烦或不必要地持续很长时间。
example_en: The meeting began to drag on without reaching a decision.
example_zh: 会议拖了很久，却没有作出决定。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示把柔软物卷起来；非正式语境也可表示到达某地。
example_en: Please roll up the map carefully after using it.
example_zh: 地图用完后请小心卷起来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示人或物转到另一面，也可指车辆翻覆。
example_en: The patient was asked to roll over onto his left side.
example_zh: 病人被要求翻身朝左侧躺。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示某个事实慢慢被充分理解，也可表示液体渗入。
example_en: It took several minutes for the surprising news to sink in.
example_zh: 大家过了几分钟才逐渐理解这个惊人的消息。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示人群分组、关系结束或整体被分成部分。
example_en: We will split up into teams of four for the activity.
example_zh: 这项活动中我们将分成四人小组。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示拆毁建筑物，也可表示把张贴物撕下来。
example_en: The city plans to tear down the unsafe bridge.
example_zh: 这座城市计划拆除那座不安全的桥。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 laughing、crying 等动名词连用，表示情绪突然爆发。
example_en: The final joke made the audience burst out laughing.
example_zh: 最后一个笑话让观众突然大笑起来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把某物丢开，或不再接受某个想法、原则或顾虑。
example_en: We should not cast aside useful traditions without careful thought.
example_zh: 我们不应未经慎重考虑就抛弃有益的传统。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示抛开限制或旧习，也可指船只解缆离岸。
example_en: The young writer tried to cast off the influence of her early work.
example_zh: 这位年轻作家试图摆脱早期作品的影响。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把散落的人或物集中到一起。
example_en: Please gather up the papers before the wind blows them away.
example_zh: 请在风把纸吹走前把它们收拢起来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示身体靠在某物上，也可表示依赖某人或迫使某人行动。
example_en: During difficult times, friends often lean on one another for support.
example_zh: 困难时期，朋友们常常相互依靠。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示经过一段时间逐渐停止使用产品、制度或做法。
example_en: The company will phase out single-use plastic packaging.
example_zh: 这家公司将逐步停止使用一次性塑料包装。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，用于要求某人降低声音或停止吵闹。
example_en: The librarian asked the noisy group to pipe down.
example_zh: 图书管理员让吵闹的一群人安静下来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用结构为 regard A as B，被动形式为 A is regarded as B。
example_en: Many readers regard these novels as classics.
example_zh: 许多读者把这些小说视为经典。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示经过考虑或讨论后最终选择某人、某物或方案。
example_en: After comparing several designs, we decided to settle on the simplest one.
example_zh: 比较了几种设计后，我们决定采用最简单的一种。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在受到攻击、批评或伤害后采取还击行动。
example_en: The team refused to give up and prepared to strike back.
example_zh: 这支队伍拒绝放弃，并准备反击。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指鸟或飞机飞起，也可较正式地表示迅速逃离。
example_en: At the first sound of danger, the birds take flight.
example_zh: 一听到危险的声音，鸟儿便飞走了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可按字面指植物生根，也可比喻思想或做法开始被接受并稳固发展。
example_en: The young trees need regular water before they take root.
example_zh: 这些幼树生根前需要定期浇水。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示礼貌地退出活动、职位或竞争。
example_en: After ten years as captain, she decided to bow out gracefully.
example_zh: 担任队长十年后，她决定从容退出。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示从原有活动或领域扩展到新的方向。
example_en: The school newspaper plans to branch out into video reporting.
example_zh: 校报计划拓展到视频报道领域。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示未经认真考虑就忽视意见、担忧或问题。
example_en: It would be unwise to brush aside the safety warnings.
example_zh: 对安全警告置之不理是不明智的。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把土地、资源或组织分割给不同的人或团体，常含批评意味。
example_en: The proposal would carve up the park into separate development areas.
example_zh: 这项提议会把公园分割成不同的开发区域。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 for 连用，表示急切或费力地寻找办法、信息或物品。
example_en: The committee began to cast about for a practical solution.
example_zh: 委员会开始四处寻找可行的解决办法。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示在作决定前反复思考某个问题或建议。
example_en: Take a day to chew over the offer before replying.
example_zh: 回复之前花一天时间仔细考虑这项提议。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示因激动而说不出话，也可指通道被堵住。
example_en: He began to choke up while thanking his former teacher.
example_zh: 他感谢以前的老师时开始哽咽。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常指问题或意外情况没有预料地出现。
example_en: Unexpected costs may crop up during a long project.
example_zh: 长期项目中可能会突然出现意外开支。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 重新提起不愉快的往事
usage_note_zh: 表示不必要地再次谈论旧问题或令人难堪的事情。
example_en: There is no need to drag up an argument that ended years ago.
example_zh: 没有必要重提多年前已经结束的争论。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示把物品折小，也可非正式地表示企业停止经营。
example_en: Fold up the chairs and store them behind the stage.
example_zh: 把椅子折起来，存放在舞台后面。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示通过伪造证据使无辜者看起来犯了罪，常用于被动语态。
example_en: The story follows a detective who discovers an attempt to frame up an innocent man.
example_zh: 这个故事讲述一名侦探发现有人企图诬陷一名无辜男子。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示通过增添内容、颜色或风格来改善某物。
example_en: A few illustrations could jazz up the presentation.
example_zh: 添加几幅插图可以让演示更生动。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示暂时放下物品，也可表示停止考虑分歧、习惯或任务。
example_en: Both sides agreed to lay aside their disagreements for the day.
example_zh: 双方同意当天暂时搁置分歧。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 to 连用，表示达到要求、标准或他人的期待。
example_en: The new material must measure up to strict safety standards.
example_zh: 这种新材料必须达到严格的安全标准。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 伸出手；主动提供帮助；联系
usage_note_zh: 可表示身体动作，也常与 to 连用表示主动联系或帮助某人。
example_en: Do not hesitate to reach out to a counselor if you need support.
example_zh: 如果你需要支持，不要犹豫，主动联系辅导员。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示用证据支持说法、复制数据以防丢失，或向后移动。
example_en: Remember to back up your files before updating the system.
example_zh: 更新系统前记得备份文件。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指关系结束、团体解散，也可表示使人群散开。
example_en: A teacher stepped in to break up the fight.
example_zh: 一名老师介入制止了打斗。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接变化、结果或事件，强调使其发生。
example_en: Better public transport could bring about a major reduction in traffic.
example_zh: 更好的公共交通可能会大幅减少道路交通量。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 偶然遇到；给人某种印象
usage_note_zh: 可表示无意中发现人或物，也可与 as 连用说明给人的感觉。
example_en: You may come across unfamiliar terms while reading the article.
example_zh: 阅读这篇文章时，你可能会遇到不熟悉的术语。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示主动提供信息、帮助或承担责任。
example_en: Several witnesses agreed to come forward after the appeal.
example_zh: 发出呼吁后，几名目击者同意站出来提供信息。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示原本隐藏或未知的事实变得公开。
example_en: New evidence may come to light during the investigation.
example_zh: 调查期间可能会发现新的证据。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示临时代替某人的工作，也可隐瞒其错误或缺席原因。
example_en: Could you cover for me while I attend the training session?
example_zh: 我参加培训时，你能临时代替我吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 on 连用，表示减少消费、开支、产量或活动。
example_en: The factory aims to cut back on water use by twenty percent.
example_zh: 这家工厂计划把用水量减少百分之二十。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 一名学生主动站出来主持讨论。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指有害气体或颗粒物进入空气并对健康或环境造成影响。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 讲座期间，学生应把每部手机都调成静音。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指社会组织生产、分配和消费活动的方式。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指经济规模、生产能力和生活水平等方面的长期变化。

example_zh: 可靠的基础设施对区域经济发展很重要。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指经济活动严重衰退并对就业、企业和生活造成广泛影响的时期。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指作品不受版权专有权限制，可依法自由使用的状态；具体范围取决于适用法律。

example_zh: 博物馆把这张老照片开放为公有领域作品。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指土地以及土地上的建筑物，也可泛指相关行业。

example_zh: 利率上升会影响房地产市场。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指一个人在幼年自然习得并首先使用的语言。

example_zh: 学生可以把新语法与自己的母语进行比较。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指从小自然习得并熟练使用某种语言的人。

example_zh: 母语使用者在不同地区仍可能使用不同词语。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 太阳能发电；太阳能动力

example_zh: 这所偏远学校使用太阳能为电脑供电。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指来自太阳辐射、可被转化和利用的能量。

example_zh: 太阳能在阳光充足的地区最为有效。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指能够吸收和释放红外辐射、促使大气保温的气体。

example_zh: 二氧化碳是人类活动产生的一种主要温室气体。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指种群数量下降到面临较高灭绝风险的物种。

example_zh: 保护栖息地对濒危物种的生存至关重要。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示一个人，复数 human beings 可泛指人类成员。

example_zh: 每个人都需要获得清洁用水。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常指利用核反应释放的能量发电或提供动力。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 移除一个物种可能影响整条食物链。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 老师鼓励学生在课堂上使用目标语言。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 每支队伍都负责检查自己的设备。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可接时间说明预定安排，也可与 to 连用说明原因或应付事项。
example_en: The train will be due at platform four in ten minutes.
example_zh: 这趟列车预计十分钟后到达四号站台。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示处于视野内，也可比喻目标即将实现。
example_en: After hours of walking, the village finally came in sight.
example_zh: 走了几个小时后，村庄终于出现在视野中。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 是 valuable 的最高级形式，通常与 the 或物主限定词连用。
example_en: Trust is our most valuable resource during a crisis.
example_zh: 危机期间，信任是我们最宝贵的资源。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 现代英语中更常写作 well-being 或 wellbeing，本条保留母表词形用于识别。
example_en: Safe housing has a direct effect on people's well being.
example_zh: 安全的住房会直接影响人们的身心福祉。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示一个人的整个身心，常与投入、奉献等含义连用。
example_en: She devoted body and soul to caring for the injured animals.
example_zh: 她全身心投入到照顾受伤动物的工作中。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示投入全部热情，也可指组织或活动最重要的推动者。
example_en: The volunteers put their heart and soul into rebuilding the playground.
example_zh: 志愿者们全心全意地重建操场。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于指出与另一个对象共有的特征或情况。
example_en: In common with many coastal towns, this area depends on tourism.
example_zh: 与许多沿海城镇一样，这个地区依赖旅游业。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在空中；可感觉到；悬而未决
usage_note_zh: 可按字面表示在空气中，也可指气氛明显或事情尚未确定。
example_en: A sense of excitement was in the air before the final performance.
example_zh: 最后一场演出前，空气中洋溢着兴奋的气氛。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在手头；在掌握中；正在处理
usage_note_zh: 可表示拥有可用资源、控制住局面或正在处理事情。
example_en: With enough supplies in hand, the team continued its journey.
example_zh: 手头有了足够物资，队伍继续前行。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在适当位置；准备就绪；正在实施
usage_note_zh: 可表示位置正确，也可说明制度或安排已经建立。
example_en: All safety measures must be in place before the event begins.
example_zh: 活动开始前，所有安全措施都必须落实到位。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示按顺序行动，也可说明一个结果进一步引起另一个结果。
example_en: Each group will in turn present its findings to the class.
example_zh: 每个小组将依次向全班汇报研究结果。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示过去存在的状态或动作现在已经停止。
example_en: The old bridge is no longer safe for heavy vehicles.
example_zh: 这座旧桥已不再适合重型车辆通行。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于连接两个对等成分，表示选择或对比。
example_en: We should repair useful items rather than throw them away.
example_zh: 我们应该修理有用的物品，而不是把它们扔掉。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于引出前述原因导致的结果，后接 of 时可引出原因。
example_en: The road was flooded; as a result, the bus service stopped.
example_zh: 道路被淹，因此公共汽车停运了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 引导方式或表语从句；与事实相反时常使用虚拟形式。
example_en: He spoke as if he had witnessed the event himself.
example_zh: 他说得仿佛亲眼目睹了这件事。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 引导让步状语从句，后接完整的主语和谓语。
example_en: Even though the route was steep, everyone reached the top safely.
example_zh: 尽管路线陡峭，所有人仍安全到达了山顶。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: of 是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。
example_en: We took the train instead of driving through the storm.
example_zh: 我们乘火车出行，没有冒雨开车。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词、代词或动名词，不能直接连接完整句子。
example_en: The outdoor concert was canceled because of strong winds.
example_zh: 由于强风，露天音乐会被取消了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接带来某种结果的人或事，常表示积极原因，也可用于反讽语境。
example_en: Thanks to careful planning, the move was completed in one day.
example_zh: 多亏周密计划，搬迁在一天内就完成了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 to do 或 against 连用，表示为解决问题而采取具体措施。
example_en: Communities must take action to protect local water sources.
example_zh: 社区必须采取行动保护当地水源。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示行动使情况发生明显改善或变化，常与 to 连用。
example_en: Even a small donation can make a difference to the project.
example_zh: 即使一小笔捐款也能对这个项目产生影响。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示处理问题、与某人打交道，也可说明文章或课程的主题。
example_en: The training teaches staff how to deal with emergencies.
example_zh: 培训教员工如何应对紧急情况。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可按字面表示道路通往某地，也可说明某事造成某种结果。
example_en: A lack of sleep can lead to poor concentration.
example_zh: 睡眠不足会导致注意力不集中。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接结果，主语通常是引发该结果的原因。
example_en: Ignoring a minor fault may result in a costly repair later.
example_zh: 忽视小故障以后可能会导致高昂的维修费用。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可说明词语所指对象、在谈话中提及，或查阅资料。
example_en: In this report, the word youth will refer to people under twenty-five.
example_zh: 在本报告中，青年一词指二十五岁以下的人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接职位、课程、许可或资金等希望获得的事物。
example_en: Eligible students may apply for financial support online.
example_zh: 符合条件的学生可以在线申请经济资助。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在某种程度上；从某一角度看
usage_note_zh: 用于限定观点，说明陈述只在某个方面成立。
example_en: In a way, the unexpected delay gave us more time to prepare.
example_zh: 从某种角度看，意外的延误给了我们更多准备时间。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接作为依据、来源或原型的人或事物。
example_en: Scientific conclusions should be based on reliable evidence.
example_zh: 科学结论应该以可靠证据为基础。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指实际发生的生活和经历，与小说、网络或模拟环境相对。
example_en: Communication can be more complex in real life than in a textbook.
example_zh: 现实生活中的交流可能比课本中更复杂。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 与某事有关；与某人有亲属关系
usage_note_zh: 后接存在联系的人或事物，具体关系由语境决定。
example_en: The change may be related to a rise in water temperature.
example_zh: 这种变化可能与水温上升有关。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指用户创建、分享内容并进行社交互动的网络平台和服务。
example_en: Information on social media should be checked before it is shared.
example_zh: 社交媒体上的信息在分享前应该核实。
